name: taplog
description: Weekly spending recaps from your TapLog export, and capture links that log on your iPhone. Stores nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Your TapLog week, explained. Nothing stored.
interface.longDescription: TapLog keeps your spending on your iPhone. Share your TapLog export to see this week against last, where the money went, and how much of it you marked impulse — read once and stored nowhere. Tell ChatGPT what you spent and get links that open TapLog pre-filled, so the entry is saved on your phone, not in the cloud.
defaultPrompt: Here's my TapLog export — how did this week go?
Log 40 for chai and 250 for lunch in TapLog.
